hook_line: CYCLONE AKVAN MAKES LANDFALL NEAR GOPALPUR IN ODISHA

hook_stat.sub: kmph gusts as Cyclone Akvan crossed the Odisha coast near Gopalpur

stats.label: Rescue teams deployed across Odisha for Cyclone Akvan
Relief camps in Odisha for people evacuated ahead of landfall
Trains cancelled by East Coast Railway as a precaution

diaspora_bullets: Over 3 lakh people were evacuated into relief camps before landfall
No casualties had been reported as the landfall process began
news_summary: Cyclone Akvan began landfall near Gopalpur on the Odisha coast on Friday morning, crossing at 70-80 kmph and gusting to 90 kmph after weakening from a severe cyclonic storm, according to the India Meteorological Department.
payoff: Odisha's government is running a zero-casualty mission, and no casualties had been reported as landfall began.
